acceptance_scenarios: Given a user has set an IGN, When they use the view-IGN command, Then the system displays their current IGN
Given a user has not set an IGN, When they use the view-IGN command, Then the system informs them that no IGN is currently set
Given a user is in a specific server, When they view their IGN, Then they see the IGN specific to that server, not IGNs from other servers

functional_requirements: FR-006: System MUST provide a slash command for users to view their current in-game name
